# Panel assay readouts - synthetic material

SYNTHETIC MATERIAL - authored for the LabCairn public fixture corpus.
Every subject code, concentration and timestamp below is invented for
testing. Nothing here comes from a human being, an animal, a clinical
encounter, or a real laboratory, and no row here may be read as a
measurement of anyone's health.

## Cohort

Twelve synthetic panels were assayed over one synthetic run. Subject
codes are `SYN-P01` through `SYN-P12`. The panels were prepared from a
synthetic reference material, so the concentrations are properties of
that material and not of any subject.

## Assay

The assay was a sandwich-type readout with a 450 nm detection
wavelength. Two technical replicates were read per panel, and the
reported value for a panel is the mean of its replicates.

## Units

Concentrations are in nanograms per millilitre. The detection
wavelength is in nanometres.
